course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Negotiate a practical solution using problem-solution connectors and polite alternatives.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing a refund, replacement, new appointment, or support follow-up.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Offering and evaluating solutions without sounding too demanding.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik prepare what to say after customer service offers a partial solution that may not be enough.

main_focus.name: solution negotiation with annars, då, and i så fall
main_focus.description: Use connectors that link a proposed solution to a condition, consequence, or alternative.
model_examples: Om återbetalning inte går, vill vi byta produkten i stället.
I så fall behöver vi en ny bekräftelse.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 4-5 problem-solution connectors, including i så fall or annars at least twice.

allowed_supporting_grammar: polite request frames with skulle vilja
passive forms for service actions if natural
avoid_grammar: legal threats or aggressive complaint language

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use negotiation chunks that support a calm but clear request for a workable solution.

dialogue_shape.opening: A proposed solution from a service provider is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They evaluate whether it solves the problem and prepare one or two polite alternatives.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose the preferred solution and the fallback request.

target_complexity.repetition: Make the negotiation practical and cooperative, not a debate about rights.

focus: the proposed solution and why it may not be enough
the alternative that would solve the problem better
the fallback plan if the preferred option is not possible

sentence_focus: one sentence with om det inte går
one sentence with i så fall
one sentence with annars as a fallback
one sentence saying a solution sounds reasonable or unreasonable
one sentence politely asking for an alternative
